gaps.term: array on a product as tensor product of arrays
gaps.quote: an array on a product is the tensor product of arrays on its factors
gaps.note: The page asserts this identification without stating or justifying it; the reader cannot check that an array indexed by a product of index sets is the tensor product of the arrays on the factors.

gaps.term: tensor product of more than two maps, giving the layer
gaps.quote: so the layer is $H_0\otimes\cdots\otimes H_0\otimes\mathrm{id}$ with $D$ copies of $H_0$
gaps.note: The page defines S tensor T only for two maps; the iterated product of D+1 maps acting as the layer is not stated, and the reader cannot check it from the page.
